cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Warmly Withholding
cards.instruction: Remain open, caring, and reassuring while revealing less with every new question.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Your school meeting went fine, love. The headteacher and I discussed your suspension. Have some tea.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. A little while. I'll be home with you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Will I miss the school play?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Oh, sweetheart. Come sit beside me. You don't have to face this alone.

mechanism: A comforts its old performance pupil through suspension questions, using familiar calming guidance to replace increasingly specific answers.
confusable: Not open refusal or simple kindness: each more precise question receives less factual disclosure through a caring coaching response.
comparison: Parental rehearsal comfort versus former workplace pupil seeking delivery facts.
